english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is frightening, shocking, or horrifying.
This is the all-purpose choice for generally frightening, skin-crawling situations; use 陰森森 for a specifically eerie atmosphere.
Use this for something genuinely horrific, frightening, or alarming.
This is the all-purpose choice for something repellently frightening, shocking, or ghastly.
Use this for something frightening in a horrifying or alarming way rather than merely startling.
Use this for a stronger horror-like or ominous impression.
Choose this when the frightening quality is especially intense or has a horror-like feel.
Use this when appalling means genuinely horrifying or frightening rather than merely very bad.
Choose this when something causes fear or feels terrifying, rather than merely being bad.
